headline_seed: Abrego Garcia Voluntarily Leaves U.S., Ending 20-Month Legal Fight - The New York Times
draft_text:
Kilmar Abrego Garcia, 31, left the US for Spain Tuesday, departing Dulles.
AP and NBC News report DHS confirmed the departure; Sen. Van Hollen called him "a free man."
His attorney says the move is temporary.

And that's the mews.
